raw_posts.name: Plurai Simulation
raw_posts.tagline: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run
raw_posts.description: Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

raw_posts.name: YouArt Desktop App
raw_posts.description: Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider.

raw_posts.name: Omnigraph
raw_posts.tagline: Open source graph database for your AI agents
raw_posts.description: Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

raw_posts.name: ⌘+L
raw_posts.description: Command L (⌘+L) is a magical script tag so you can edit your website like a Figma file. In the background, Claude Code, Codex, or Letterpress-1 will automatically turn the change into the perfect pull request.

raw_posts.name: Spacefast by Automattic
raw_posts.tagline: Give your AI agents a place to build, run, and ship
raw_posts.description: Spacefast is a new way to ship websites and apps with the AI you already use. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your favorite agent, and publish your project with a simple request. Spacefast handles hosting, databases, domains, file uploads, and version history. Share private links, collect feedback directly on your pages, and let your agent make updates. Built by Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com. Free to start, with no extra AI subscription.

raw_posts.name: Adobe AI Assistant
raw_posts.tagline: Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps
raw_posts.description: Adobe AI Assistant brings conversational AI into Creative Cloud. Describe what you want to accomplish, and let it handle multi-step creative tasks across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Firefly.

raw_posts.name: Harness Memory
raw_posts.tagline: Long-term memory for agents, across every harness
raw_posts.description: Harness Memory gives every harness agent its own long-term memory. Pick a memory engine (Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, ReMe, or your own) and plug it into different agent harnesses, like Claude Code, Codex and Hermes. Memory can be shared across agent harnesses, with fine-grained access control. Open source in Community Edition and available on HarnessRouter Cloud.

raw_posts.name: three.dev
raw_posts.tagline: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.
raw_posts.description: Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.
